{{< include ./_extensions/r-wasm/live/_knitr.qmd >}}

The same statcheck as in [Version B](version_b.qmd), but as editable R code.

Change the results below, or add your own, and press **Run Code**.

```{webr}
results <- c(
  "t(58) = 1.46, p = .03",
  "t(28) = 2.0, p < .05",
  "F(1, 7) = 12.19, p < .001",
  "r(40) = -.30, p = .03",
  "t(30) = 2.10, p = .000"
)
statcheck(results)
```

The same results, treated as one-sided tests:

```{webr}
statcheck(results, OneTailedTests = TRUE)
```
